review_status: AI independent provisional review; NOT human adjudication or ground truth

independence.label_basis: Supplied case narrative and allowed classes, with canonical rubric interpretation. Input claims are synthetic stipulated evidence, not independently verified native artifacts.
independence.publication_note: Source paths relocated for this repository packet; case content, labels, rationale, original source hashes and provisional status are unchanged.

scope.variant_rule: Subject-ID and padding changes have no semantic effect; paired labels, alternatives, rationales and guard dispositions are identical.
scope.evaluation_eligibility: All seed families remain development material. Prototype calibration/heldout fields confer no heldout eligibility; variants never increase independent N.
scope.scoring_status: No accuracy, agreement, guard-preservation, calibration, or release-gate claim is justified. Null labels block scoring and all labels still require the prescribed two independent humans plus adjudication.

taxonomy_review.runtime_general: Protocol lists class names without operational definitions, precedence, multi-cause handling, or explicit out-of-domain policy. Non-null runtime labels use the ordinary causal/outcome interpretations stated per case.

protected_branch_refusal.resolution_needed: Define a policy_refusal/held state or explicitly specify a documented mapping into the existing ontology. Preserve a definitive refused outcome independently of label.

scope_revision.resolution_needed: Freeze whether labels target the submitted snapshot or current scope, and keep version freshness as a separate applicability field.

manual_overrides.resolution_needed: Distinguish inferred complexity from observed manual selection. Decide sufficiency of the supplied bounded-work description; explicit selection never grants overwrite authority.

typed_epics.resolution_needed: Define non-executable/inapplicable handling before scoring: exclude epic inputs or add an explicit applicability status/class. Child dispatch must continue to use child complexity.

taxonomy_review.missing_scope_vs_default: insufficient_evidence denotes inability to assess scope; missing product values default to medium and remain unassessed. These are separate concepts.
human_work_required: Review and freeze taxonomy and target-version semantics before expanding the corpus or scoring.
Have two humans independently label cases without exposure to author hypotheses; adjudicate disagreements and unresolved applicability afterward.
